description: A PERSONAL MESSAGE FROM VICTOR… 48 Hours. Three Events. And Something Is Happening. In the last 48 hours, we held three events across Colorado… What struck me wasn’t just the turnout, It was who was there. I met men and women who told me they have never attended a political rally in their lives. Others said they stopped voting years ago. Not because they stopped caring, but because they felt like their voice didn’t matter anymore. They were tired of the dysfunction. Tired of the infighting. Tire
title: TEAM VICTOR WEEKLY UPDATE February 22, 2026
